sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static conditional requirement: it requires an explicit treatment-plant applicability value, constrains the applicable branch to approved and compliant canonical statuses plus true discharge compliance, and requires each discharge-distance record to contain both required nautical-mile quantities without imposing an unsupported numerical threshold. Owners, relationship path, datatypes, units, and canonical namespace are correct.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate does not faithfully encode the declared comparison values: the dependency contract requires the MARPOL regulation 9.1.1/9.2.1 certification status and regulation 11.1.2 discharge status to be compliant, but it constrains the certification status to evidenceStateApproved. Use the canonical controlled value for compliant certification status (locate it if absent from the scoped vocabulary) and preserve the boolean true requirement for discharge compliance. Also account for the COMPLETE contract's declared MARPOL certification and discharge status terms without duplicating facts on an incompatible owner.

The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static conditional requirement: it requires an explicit treatment-plant applicability value, constrains the applicable branch to approved and compliant canonical statuses plus true discharge compliance, and requires each discharge-distance record to contain both required nautical-mile quantities without imposing an unsupported numerical threshold. Owners, relationship path, datatypes, units, and canonical namespace are correct.
